verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lists a 'Bits AI' docs page and an 'Incident Management' docs page by title only. Neither item contains any content describing AI-generated incident summaries or alert context for responders. The axis clearly applies to an observability and incident platform, but nothing in the pack documents the capability, and outside knowledge cannot fill the gap.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders
